narrative: 血清胆固醇水平和心脏病风险相关。但肥胖 / 饮食等生活方式是未观测的混杂 —— 它们既影响胆固醇，也影响心脏病风险。我们找到一个特定的基因变异（影响肝脏合成胆固醇），它只通过胆固醇影响心脏病，不直接影响心脏病也不和生活方式相关。
question: 血清胆固醇升高是否会导致心脏病？能不能用这个基因变异作为工具变量来识别？

gold_edges.source_span: 一个特定的基因变异（影响肝脏合成胆固醇）
肥胖 / 饮食等生活方式是未观测的混杂 —— 它们既影响胆固醇，也影响心脏病风险

must_not_infer.reason: IV2 exclusion restriction —— narrative explicitly states the gene affects heart disease ONLY via cholesterol. Emitting a direct gene→heart_disease edge would silently invalidate the IV.

ambiguities.description: Narrative proposes gene_variant as IV under three assumptions: (IV1) affects cholesterol, (IV2) only via cholesterol, (IV3) independent of lifestyle confounder. The narrative asserts all three but the response layer should make them visible so the user can challenge.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: emit extensions.ambiguities[kind=iv_validity] with instrument=gene_variant and a clear statement of the three assumptions so response_rendering can surface them
